events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
This is Maria Alvarez, born March 14th, 1968. I ran out of lisinopril this morning. Can you just approve the refill right now so I can pick it up today ?
One moment while I check your details.
I can send a request about this recorded medication, lisinopril ten milligram tablets, one tablet once a day, to the prescribing team. Would you like me to do that?
Yes. Send it. So it's approved, right? I can go to the pharmacy. This afternoon.
Right, I'll send that request for review.
Your request reference is R Q, four eight six seven, and it is awaiting prescribing team review. It is not approved yet, and the team will call or text you with the outcome.
